newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks up to 35,000 tonnes of edible oils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks up to 35,000 tonnes of edible oils.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Thursday it wanted to buy up to 35,000 tonnes of assorted edible oils for delivery in the first half January.
The deadline for bids is noon (1000 GMT) on November 27, said Muharram Ghanem, head of sales at the company.
The oils are in three lots,
-- 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of crude sunflower oil or semi-refined cottonseed oil or U.S. cottonseed oil grade 162.
-- 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soyoil, any origin.
-- 10,000 tonnes of palm oil of Malaysian or Indonesian origin.
